summary: Receives the insulation-monitor indication associated with the negative side of the assigned DC system.
description: Receives the insulation-monitor indication associated with the negative side of the assigned DC system. A room DC interface connects station battery distribution, alarm contacts and operating circuits. DC supplies may remain energized when the room's normal AC supply is unavailable, so their source and distribution boundaries must be shown separately.

In a switchroom, the station battery can continue supplying protection and breaker controls during an AC supply interruption. The alarm system should distinguish charger loss from a low battery condition. For this reference, the drawing identifies “DC insulation-monitor output” at the input and “Negative-side earth indication” at the output. Alarm polarity depends on the monitoring implementation.
